name: Hilkenbrook (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and red with a narrow white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hilkenbrook (a horseshoe, a wavy bend and a spade on red and green).
history: The flag is green-white-red striped in the proportions 11.5:1:11.5 with the arms, which carry an additional white outline on the flag.

features.role: Hilkenbrook arms — horseshoe, wavy bend and spade
